title: Service and ridership after electrification
question: Did the service expansion produce more passenger trips?
finding: Caltrain estimates 9.1 million trips in FY2025 and 12.6 million in FY2026, up 37.6% using unrounded counts. Weekend service increased from 32 to 66 trains per day. June 2026 ridership reached 81.6% of June 2019.
how: Use the two annual ridership reports for like-for-like agency estimates. The Board adopted an FY2026 operating budget of nearly $260 million and a separate $34.8 million capital budget.
limits: These are agency ridership estimates. Counting methods differ from federal transit reporting. The approved FY2026 budget includes debt expense and cannot substitute for final operating expenses on the annual financial report’s accounting basis.
